commits.message:
Streamline the admin runbook and README; accept hand-edited format answers

ADMIN.md now covers end-to-end admin work: approving, changes, format/date
changes after approval, speakers backing out, collisions, no-account
proposals, and calendar edits (add/cancel/restore/reshape/move dates).
README is trimmed to what the tool is, how to propose, and how to develop.

A speaker editing the issue by hand can now write the format as the full
option, the short name, or the key, and the error lists the exact options.

commits.message:
Fix HTTP 406 on submit: rename the "format" form field to "talk-format"

Field ids become query parameters on github.com/<repo>/issues/new, and Rails
treats ?format= as the response type, so "Lightning talk (20 min)" returned
406 Not Acceptable. Add a reserved-id guard to form.json validation so this
cannot come back.
